_README: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Every figure below is illustrative, not sourced. Before this project is demoed or submitted, replace these with real numbers: (1) tuition_per_credit_hour from your university's published tuition/fee schedule, (2) median_starting_salary from College Scorecard (collegescorecard.ed.gov) filtered by institution + field of study, (3) credits_required from your university's degree catalog. Each figure has its OWN source/source_date pair because they come from different documents — the provenance panel reads these directly, so a credit requirement must not cite a salary dataset.
